confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on aggregated 2026 estimates and street-level examples, so they are moderately reliable. Beer and cocktail anchors are sparser and draw on Taipei and craft-bar data. wine_glass is derived from the beer anchor using an assumed 2.5x restaurant ratio because no NT$ wine-by-the-glass price was found. The four accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge; no booking pages or listings were checked. The FX rate comes from a search-result summary of the RBA exchange-rates page that I did not open directly, and the 2026-10-16 observation may not yet be published, so verify it before use. Currency conversion assumes about NT$31 per US$.
comparable_city_reasoning: Kaohsiung is priced as a somewhat cheaper sibling of Taipei and Taichung. Cocktail and craft-beer points come from Taipei bar guides, while meal and coffee anchors use Kaohsiung-specific estimates and national or chain price points. Hostel and hotel tiers reflect general knowledge of mid-sized Taiwanese cities.
